Test Case 1: Load templates from embedded imports

Input: Load all bootstrap templates using BootstrapTemplates.loadAll()

Expected Output:
- Success: true
- Template count: 6
- Template IDs (sorted): create-activity, debug-activity-self-contained, evolve-activity-self-contained, manage-session-memory, trace-data-flow-single-feature, trace-enforce-validate-loop
- Source: embedded-imports

Validation Logic:
1. Import BootstrapTemplates module
2. Call loadAll() function
3. Verify 6 templates are returned
4. Verify all expected template IDs are present
5. Confirm templates loaded from embedded imports (not filesystem)

Success Criteria:
- All 6 templates load successfully
- No filesystem I/O performed
- Template IDs match expected list
